setupWorld: create a pybullet simulation world with a KUKA robot arm and 50 stacked cubes
dumpStateToFile: dump the position, orientation, and velocity of all bodies in the simulation to a text file
compareFiles: compare two state dump files using unified diff and report the number of differing lines
saveBullet_restoreState: save the full simulation state to a bullet file and restore it later to verify determinism
saveState_removeState: save an in-memory simulation snapshot with saveState and remove it with removeState
